title: Edge AI LLM Inference Benchmarking on T3 Gemstone O1 and Arduino UNO Q
description: Reproducible edge-AI LLM inference benchmarks using llama.cpp on the T3 Gemstone O1 (TI AM67A) and the Arduino UNO Q (Qualcomm QRB2210). The repository contains the benchmark harness, raw llama.cpp output, aggregated CSV data, perplexity and accuracy evaluation scripts, and analysis tooling. Code is MIT-licensed; benchmark data and documentation are CC BY 4.0. The current dataset is preliminary and incomplete; the README documents exactly which configurations are missing.
